headline: Steady earnings growth, guidance reaffirmed
summary_short: Evergy reported Q2 2026 GAAP net income of $215.0M, or $0.91 diluted EPS (+23.0% y/y from $0.74), on revenue of $1,500.1M (+4.4% y/y); adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS was $0.88 vs $0.82 a year ago, and the company reaffirmed full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.14-$4.34.
summary_long: Second-quarter revenue of $1,500.1M rose 4.4% y/y as net income grew 25.5% to $215.0M and diluted EPS rose to $0.91 from $0.74. Operating income increased 9.5% y/y to $376.3M and EBITDA grew 12.4% to $720.2M. Adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS was $0.88, up from $0.82, which management attributed to recovery of regulated investments, weather-normalized demand growth, and higher large-customer revenue, partly offset by higher operations & maintenance and depreciation & amortization expense. The board declared a $0.6950/share quarterly dividend, payable September 18, 2026. Evergy reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.14-$4.34 (midpoint $4.24) and its long-term adjusted EPS annual growth target of 6%-8%+ through 2030, with growth expected to exceed 8% from 2028.
